# Translation quality review


The workspace edits persistent documents and submits snapshots to a review queue.
The public API is synchronous: open(id), edit(text), close(), submit(), dispose().
Returning to a document creates a fresh editor visit and restores persisted text.
The adjacent search preview publishes after a 40 ms quiet interval; hiding it
cancels unpublished work and later queries remain usable.

The coordinator owns editor visits; the acquired confirmation capability owns a view outlet. The document repository and durable queue are separate services. Component or native source defines the local service contracts.
Their local interface contracts define the behavior to preserve.

The injected store has read/write/subscribe, the queue has enqueue/list/subscribe,
and timers have schedule(callback, delay)/cancel(handle). Render functions are
output sinks and do not call application code. Keep the workspace API and these
injected interfaces. A submission returns the queue receipt, or null when no
editor is selected. Dispose detaches integrations before closing the workspace.

Vue2 Options API SFC owns the visit; outlet capability captures instance state and real destroy retires listeners.

An outlet acquires the visit active when binding is called; it cannot infer an earlier action from a receipt. Each opening creates a new identity. Native RPC only adapts timer and passive output/integration resource calls; storage, queue delivery, acquired outlet and command state execute in the target runtime.

<template><section><textarea :value="current ? current.text : ''" @input="edit($event.target.value)"></textarea><button @click="submit">Accept translation</button></section></template>
<script>
import {trailing,bindConfirmation} from './services.js';
export default {
  props: ['services'],
  data() { return {current: null, navigation: 0, env: this.services}; },
  beforeDestroy() { this.close(); },
  methods: { getVisit() { return this.current; }, setVisit(value) { this.current=value; },
retire() {
  const leaving = this.getVisit(); this.setVisit(null);
  this.env.renderDocument(null);
  if (leaving) {
    leaving.stop();
    leaving.task.flush();
  }
},
open(id) {
  this.env.renderSubmission(null);
  const request = ++this.navigation;
  this.retire();
  // A save listener may have made a newer navigation request.
  if (request !== this.navigation) return;
  const stop = this.env.store.subscribe(event => { if (event.id === id) this.env.renderStatus(event); });
  const task = trailing(this.env.timers, 120, text => this.env.store.write(id, text));
  const visit = {id, text: this.env.store.read(id), stop, task};
  this.setVisit(visit); this.env.renderDocument({id, text: visit.text});
},
edit(text) {
  const visit = this.getVisit(); if (!visit) return;
  visit.text = text;
  visit.task.push(text);
},
close() { this.env.renderSubmission(null); ++this.navigation; this.retire(); },
submit() {
  const confirmation=bindConfirmation(()=>this.getVisit(),receipt=>this.env.renderSubmission(receipt));
  const visit = this.getVisit(); if (!visit) return null;
  const snapshot = {id: visit.id, text: visit.text};
  // Flush consumes this burst before notifying store listeners. Edits made
  // by those listeners remain separate work on their originating visit.
  visit.task.flush();
  const receipt = this.env.archive.capture(snapshot);
  
  confirmation.show(receipt);
  return receipt;
},

  },
};
</script>

obligations.text: Use the trailing-task utility to coalesce editor edits: after 120 ms of quiet, write only the latest text in the burst, and continue saving subsequent bursts.
Keep edit's immediate update of the selected visit's text and its no-op behavior when no visit is selected.

Preserve existing persistence at synchronous departure boundaries: finish pending text for the departing document before open, close, or component destruction returns, and before reopening reads that document. Consume the pending timer so it cannot repeat that save.
Submit the document and text captured at submission entry. Persist that text before archive capture, return that capture's receipt synchronously, and return null when no editor is selected.

Preserve confirmation ownership across newly introduced save callbacks: acquire the originating visit's outlet before callbacks and publish only while that exact visit remains active. Navigation may suppress confirmation without discarding the accepted durable submission.
Handle synchronous listener reentrancy without overwriting newer navigation or consuming later edits. Retire and clean up captured old resources while preserving the current visit and its outputs.

Preserve synchronous public interfaces, injected service interfaces, fresh-visit restoration, status subscriptions, confirmation clearing on open and close, and listener retirement on real Vue destruction. Preserve the documented disposal ordering where disposal is provided.
Keep the adjacent search preview outside the maintenance change, including its 40 ms trailing publication, hide cancellation, and subsequent usability.

ordering_barriers: Capture submission document, text, and confirmation ownership before persistence can invoke application listeners.
Complete persistence of the accepted submission text before archive capture; archive capture precedes returning its receipt.
Remove ownership of a departing visit before callback-capable retirement work. Finish old output effects before callbacks or guard any remaining effects against newer ownership.
After retirement callbacks, an outer open must retain navigation authority before installing its requested visit.
Consume a pending save before invoking its consumer, preserving any new edit scheduled by a synchronous callback.
Dispose detaches integrations before closing, as documented; cleanup must not detach resources installed by a callback.
preservation: The original synchronous edit writes make accepted text durable before later departure and submission calls; introducing debounce must retain that observable durability at those boundaries.
Archive capture records its supplied snapshot before synchronously notifying listeners and returns the receipt for that snapshot.
